'''Garig-Ilgar''', after its two dialects, is an extinct [[Iwaidjan languages|Iwaidjan language]] spoken in the mainland of [[Cobourg Peninsula]], around [[Port Essington]], [[Northern Territory]].

Unlike many Australian languages, Ilgar does not have [[Laminal consonant|lamino-alveolar]]s.

===Vowels===
Evans (1998) briefly discusses vowels in his paper noting that Iwaidjan languages including Ilgar have a three vowel (/a/, /i/, /u/) system typical of most Australian languages.
